title: Primitives
subtitle: Every control of the shell in every state, from DESIGN.md

bars.title: Bars
bars.note: Islands as the shell composes them: one control height, one centre line, 8 px between controls and 17 px across a separator.
bars.diffDetail: {{devices}} devices and {{cables}} cables changed since 12 Jan
bars.l2Soon: Layer 2, VLANs and trunks: in progress

controls.iconNote: 32 by 32, a 16 px icon, always a tooltip; a toggle carries the accent rail when it is on.
controls.buttonNote: Words for a choice; the primary fill once per surface at most; a line button where it must read as a control.

inputs.title: Fields and choices
inputs.note: A paper field with a line border, the accent border on focus; a segmented choice on a ground track; a choice that opens a list.

feedback.title: Counts, shortcuts, toasts, scrim
feedback.note: A count is a number in its state colour; a toast says what just happened; the scrim fades what is behind a palette.
feedback.scrimBody: It rises over the scrim, centred in the upper third of the map.
feedback.partial: Partial collection: 2 devices did not answer

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.note: One tooltip for the whole application: black, white words, the shortcut in grey; below its control, toward the inside near an edge.

panel.title: Panel, table, popover
panel.note: The compact panel with its header actions, its alerts in words, its facts and a sortable table; a popover opens under its trigger and may cover islands.
panel.layerNote: The layer shadow: the search palette and the focus panel only.
panel.alert1Detail: port-channel20 and port-channel21 have no active member left
panel.alert2: Different speed at the two ends of a cable
panel.alert3: Two cables documented but never observed
panel.strip: Facts as a strip: the focus panel's header band
panel.alertsCaption: Alerts: a mark, a sentence, a detail

widgets.title: Widgets, avatars, marks
widgets.note: A widget is an island of the home: a 56 px header (title, count, then on the right a segmented filter and the icon buttons, the settings last) over a table or a feed. An avatar is a declared author's initial; a mark is a state's 8 px square, alone or before its words.
widgets.widget: Widget, with its filter and its settings, sortable headers
widgets.widgetPlain: Widget without controls, snug table, a foot note
widgets.avatars: Avatars, and in the user button
widgets.marks: Marks, alone and with their words
widgets.links: Links: inline (accent-ink, underlined under the ink accent), focused, quiet (a name that opens its row), the logo

palette.title: Search palette
palette.note: The layer Ctrl+K opens over the scrim: the field, the tabs by kind with their counts, the results grouped with the matched part strong, the current row on accent-weak with its Enter chip, the detail column, the shortcuts. Shown here in the flow of the page; the arrows walk it.
palette.label: Search
palette.placeholder: A device, a port, a description…
palette.alert: Two aggregates out of service toward the firewalls
